displayName: Sprintable — Expo push credentials error (dev · prod)

documentation.content: story 4694. The backend logged `expo_push_credentials_error`: Expo refused a push ticket with a credentials-class error (`InvalidCredentials` · `MismatchSenderId`) — the push credentials of the app's Firebase / FCM key, not the recipient. **Every push of that app is refused until it is fixed** (the 10-08~10-15 week: the dev Firebase key's restriction vs the .dev re-signed app). Look at the line's `codes` · `event_type` · `devices` (ids and counts only), then the key's Android restriction in the project's API keys. Receipts are another line (`expo receipts:`).

displayName: Sprintable — Expo push credentials error (VM backends dev · prod)

documentation.content: story 4694 (the VM half · after story 4796 moved the backends off Cloud Run: dev 10-27, prod 10-29). The backend on a VM logged `expo_push_credentials_error`: Expo refused a push ticket with a credentials-class error (`InvalidCredentials` · `MismatchSenderId`) — the push credentials of the app's Firebase / FCM key, not the recipient. **Every push of that app is refused until it is fixed.** This policy only sees the line if the container logs reach Cloud Logging (Ops Agent · story 4869) — the Cloud Run policy of the same name above matches nothing once the Cloud Run backends are gone. Look at the line's `codes` · `event_type` · `devices` (ids and counts only), then the key's Android restriction in the project's API keys.
